title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression metrics integration and quality-gating hook
author: Lina Morales
description: Motivation: Add stronger automated eval gating to catch prompt-set regressions and metric-level quality drops before they reach production. This PR integrates the eval-harness metrics pipeline into CI, adds a new 'prompt-regression' CI hook that evaluates changed prompt sets and compares against baseline metrics, and implements a configurable quality-gate step that fails the PR when key metrics cross regression thresholds. Changes include metric ingestion (EM, ROUGE-L, embedding-sim), aggregation/reporting, and a lightweight CSV-based baseline store for prompt sets. Checklist: - [x] Integrate metric calculators into eval-harness CI runner - [x] Add prompt-regression CI hook and config parsing - [x] Implement quality-gate thresholds and failing behavior - [x] Wire results to CI annotations and console output - [x] Add unit and integration tests for metric calculations - [x] Update docs and add Linear links Context: Teams have seen silent prompt regressions when prompt-set edits change tokenization or expects slightly different responses; this PR provides deterministic eval checks that run on PRs touching prompt definitions or eval configs. How it works (high level): - On push/PR, the eval CI hook identifies changed prompt sets under eval-harness/prompts/ and runs the eval suite against the pinned baseline model set in ci/eval/baselines.csv. - Calculated metrics (EM, ROUGE-L, embedding cosine similarity) are aggregated per-prompt and summarized to a single per-set score. - Quality-gate compares delta relative to baseline; thresholds are configurable via .eval-ci/config.yaml (defaults: em:-0.01, rouge_l:-0.02, embed_sim:-0.015). - If any metric for a prompt set exceeds its threshold, the hook marks the CI job as failed and posts an annotation with the top 5 regressions and links to detailed artifacts. Rollout plan: - Feature-flag enabled for a subset of repos via ci hooks config - Initial thresholds conservative; will tighten after two weeks of telemetry - Add opt-out per-PR via [skip-eval-gate] tag when necessary Related: ENG-1422 implements follow-on telemetry dashboard, ENG-2101 documents the prompt baseline format. Notes: - This PR intentionally keeps baseline store simple (CSV) to avoid migration complexity; follow-up will add a small baseline service. - Some tests required mocking large model runs; integration tests use cached model outputs to keep CI time bounded.

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Nice end-to-end flow. A few nits: (1) can we make the default thresholds live in code + config so tests can import them? (2) please add a short note in the PR summary about how to bypass the gate during emergency fixes.
Lina Morales: replied to Aisha: moved defaults into eval_harness/ci/defaults.py and referenced them in config; added bypass docs and the [skip-eval-gate] opt-out in README.
Marco Liu: There's a flaky test 'test_embedding_sim_large' in CI that failed on my first run — looks like the cached vector file path isn't hermetic. Can we pin the temp dir?
Lina Morales: replied to Marco: fixed test to use tmp_path fixture and re-ran local suite; updated test to assert relative tolerance to avoid noise from numeric differences.
Evan Ross: Approve after Marco's nit — please ensure baselines.csv is not accidentally used for private customer baselines in private deployments (sensitive).
Lina Morales: noted; added explicit comment in ci/eval/baselines.csv header and code checks to prevent loading baselines from private/ paths.
release_notes: Add prompt-regression CI hook and eval metrics integration (EM, ROUGE-L, embedding similarity). Configurable quality-gate with conservative defaults to block obvious regressions. Docs updated.
notes: This PR was part of a multi-PR effort; follow-ups will replace CSV baselines with a baseline service and add a dashboard for per-prompt telemetry. Monitored in canary for two weeks post-merge.
